Track 01 · Computer Programming 1 · Weeks 2–14

50 concepts. 500 authored labs.

Flowcharts, algorithms, C fundamentals, variables, scope, operators, conditionals, loops, arrays, functions, and debugging. Every concept has ten labs and every lab uses a different one of twelve hands-on mechanics. Weeks 9–14 are a finals extension beyond the week-8 syllabus.
